description: MindSpark is an open-source mind-mapping app you actually own - no accounts, no paywalls, no feature gates, no usage limits. Self-host it in one command, run it free in the browser with every map saved to your own private GitHub repo, or add one small Cloudflare Worker to unlock real-time sharing and collaboration. It's vanilla JavaScript with zero runtime dependencies, MIT-licensed, AI-assisted, and yours to run, modify, and extend.
name: Mind Spark
